# Kirollos Magdy

> Kirollos Magdy (also written Kiro Magdy, Kerolos Magdy, كيرلس مجدي) is a Full-Stack .NET Developer based in Alexandria, Egypt. He builds web and desktop applications with ASP.NET Core, C#, SQL Server, React.js, Next.js and .NET MAUI, and handles the full delivery cycle from system design to server configuration and live production deployment.

This is his personal portfolio site, kiromagdy.com. It lists his selected projects, certificates and contact details. Several projects are live systems used by real business clients.

## Profile

- [Home](https://kiromagdy.com/): About, skills, certificates, recent projects and contact details
- [CV (PDF)](https://kiromagdy.com/CV/CV_Kirollos_Magdy.pdf): Résumé
- [Selected work](https://kiromagdy.com/work): All projects in one list

## Projects

- [Jewelry System](https://kiromagdy.com/jewelry-system): Enterprise .NET 10 ERP for jewelers with dynamic formula pricing, dual-currency accounting and QuestPDF invoices
- [KMZ Hub](https://kiromagdy.com/kmz-hub): Offline-first Windows desktop app (.NET 10 MAUI Blazor Hybrid) for PlayStation centers with multi-rate timers, POS and thermal printing
- [Travely](https://kiromagdy.com/travely): .NET 9 ASP.NET Core MVC hotel booking platform with automated night pricing, Stripe checkout, BCrypt auth and an admin dashboard
- [Physiotherapy](https://kiromagdy.com/physiotherapy): Live clinic website for Dr. Michael Nabil's physiotherapy and clinical nutrition practice in Dokki, built with Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS
- [Tahwega Cafe](https://kiromagdy.com/tahwega-cafe): Live cafe website for a real client, presenting its menu, location and character
- [Teta's Kitchen](https://kiromagdy.com/teta-kitchen): Recipe and culinary heritage website in pure HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, with live search and inline editing
- [Word of the Lord](https://kiromagdy.com/word-of-the-lord): Digital platform for Coptic Christian teachings, sermons, Bible reading and liturgical texts
- [Code Crate](https://kiromagdy.com/code-crate): 6-page e-learning frontend with 12 programming and design courses across 4 learning tracks
- [Div Store](https://kiromagdy.com/div-store): 18-page electronics e-commerce frontend prototype with product variant selectors and localStorage state
- [IP Inspector](https://kiromagdy.com/ip-inspector): Real-time IP intelligence tool showing public IPv4 details, connection metrics and geolocation on interactive maps
